description: Certificate of analysis vs specification: pass, fail or indeterminate per clause — Checks the values on a certificate of analysis or test report against specification limits clause by clause (up to 200 clauses), for an agent accepting a lot or a supplier's material. Each clause has a parameter, an optional min and max and a unit; each result has a value, an optional reported uncertainty and an optional less-than or greater-than qualifier ("<0.01"). rule simple (default): the rep

max.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

min.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

conversions.description: Caller-supplied unit conversions; none are built in.

factor.description: value in `to` = value in `from` x factor.

qualifier.description: Censored result: the true value is below / above `value`.

uncertainty.description: Expanded uncertainty U (absolute, same unit as value) so the interval is value +/- U.

value.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

name: coa-gate
